title: Uncollapsed untracked and staged exact-file comparison
failure_signature: Default porcelain output collapsed a new phase directory and produced a false missing-file report.
candidate_workaround: Use git status --porcelain -uall before staging, direct expected-path existence checks, and git diff --cached --name-only after staging.
recurrence_guard: An exact file-set receipt must enumerate leaf paths, not a collapsed directory placeholder.
rollback: Retain the inaccurate comparison, make no commit from it, and rerun against uncollapsed or staged leaf paths.
scope_boundary: Git file-set enumeration only; content, privacy, and semantic validation remain separate.
